enabled.description: false unloads the skin and keeps the daemon idle.

port.description: DevTools port used by the start script and the daemon.

marker.description: Value of html[data-ccs-skin]; change it when you clone this skin.

codexBrowser.description: The Codex browser pane is a <webview> guest view; these flags keep it rendering normally.

safe.description: Suspend theme styles and decorations for browser compatibility diagnostics.

opaqueHost.description: Legacy setting kept for existing configurations. The browser host uses native styles.

surface.description: Chat canvas fill, keep some alpha so the artwork shows.

mode.description: fixed uses `asset`; random picks one entry from `list` on every re-inject; rotate cycles `list` every `rotateMs` (runtime, pausable from the picker).

rotateMs.description: Dwell time per wallpaper when mode is rotate (milliseconds).

picker.description: Show the in-app background panel (thumbnail grid with names + loop switch).

list.description: Wallpapers in display order; also the rotate sequence and the picker grid.

asset.description: Path relative to the project root, or absolute.

layer.description: back keeps text readable; front is a cutout above the UI.

offset.description: Inset from the chosen side; negative values pull the cutout off-screen.

assistant.description: Sol, the state-driven desktop assistant in the bottom-right corner.

mode.description: bubble = standing figure + emote bubble; pose = the emote itself is the character.

size.description: CSS height of the figure, e.g. 30vh.

visible.description: Initial visibility; the toggle button and localStorage override it at runtime.

controls.description: Show the small eye button that hides/brings back Sol.

doneMs.description: How long the celebration state lasts.

smileMs.description: How long the post-reply smile lasts before going idle.

quiescenceMs.description: Text must stop changing this long to count as finished.

interactive.description: Local-only interactions (no network, no message content).

enabled.description: Master switch for the transparent hit area.

click.description: React to clicks with a line and a short emote.

drag.description: Drag Sol anywhere inside the window; position is remembered.

hover.description: Lift / glow while the pointer is over her.

idle.description: Occasional small gestures when the user is away.

captionMs.description: How long a spoken line stays on screen.

idleMs.description: Idle time before Sol starts doing small gestures.

greet.description: Greet once per session based on the local hour.

pet.description: Milestone pet counts to lines, e.g. { "3": "唔…好痒" }.

body.description: Transparent full-body PNG used in bubble mode.
